name: Seeker of Enlightenment (Abbey of the Golden Sparrow)
body:
You arrived at the mountain because you were seeking the enlightenment offered by the monks, overcoming many obstacles to do so.

Benefit: You receive a +2 trait bonus to Constitution checks to avoid nonlethal damage from forced march, starvation, or thirst.
